text:
David Livingston posts series of brief messages referencing Democrats and unspecified events
By
B. S. MartinDavid Livingston, a Republican who was elected to the Arizona State House in 2023 representing the 28th House District, posted a series of brief statements on his social media account on July 15, 2026.
In his first post at 00:30 UTC, Livingston wrote: "Today's democrats https://t.co/CkL2G15yoM".
Later that morning at 03:11 UTC, he followed up with another message: "Captured https://t.co/MEY3mGpq70".
Shortly after, at 03:31 UTC, Livingston posted a third statement: "ELIMINATED https://t.co/zqVjkHbITa".
Livingston succeeded Kelli Butler as the representative for Arizona's 28th House District after being elected in 2023. His recent posts reflect his ongoing activity and presence on social media platforms.
